name: Infinite Parts
desc:
A simple incremental-style game where you collect parts, buy upgrades, collect more parts, to infinity!

UPDATE 4:
- 2 New Rebirth Upgrades
- Buy Max Upgrades setting
- Hide Players setting
- Rebirths are easier to get
- Rebirth UI now shows what area you can start rebirth
- More bug-fixes, optimizations, and improvements

Please report any bugs you find or feedback on rebirth progression!
